live.instructions: BeeGone live bee removal (UK). Sequence: beegone_get_questions first (locations, question steps, plans); ask the customer that location's questions; beegone_get_quote for chimney/wall/roof gives instant per-plan prices (Pollen/Nectar/Honey, VAT included); after the customer picks a plan and agrees to the Hive Rules, beegone_request_visit files the request — a specialist always calls to confirm; no payment is taken online. Other locations become surveyor callbacks via the same request tool; bumblebees get advice, and a nest that genuinely cannot stay can be requested as a nest move with the same request tool (from £125 to move a bumblebee nest; nests inside walls, lofts or needing access work are quoted after a survey).

tools.name: beegone_get_questions
tools.title: Beegone quote questions
tools.description: Get BeeGone's live bee-removal question model: every property location (chimney, wall, roof, tree, attic…), its sub-types and question steps with answer values, the three guarantee plans (Pollen/Nectar/Honey), contact requirements, and the consultation-booker handoff details. Call this FIRST and ask the customer the questions for their location. Chimney, wall and roof jobs get instant online prices; other locations are scoped by a surveyor in person; bumblebees (garden-compost) are usually best left alone — advice first, and BeeGone moves a nest that genuinely cannot stay (from £125 to move a bumblebee nest; nests inside walls, lofts or needing access work are quoted after a survey). Quotes are estimates a specialist confirms by phone before any work.

tools.name: beegone_get_quote
tools.title: Instant bee removal guide price
tools.description: Get an instant guide price for a quotable BeeGone job (chimney, wall or roof) from the customer's answers and postcode. Returns totals for all three plans — Pollen (no guarantee), Nectar (4-year), Honey (10-year) — VAT and travel included, as one combined figure per plan (never itemised). Show the customer all three and let them choose. For non-quotable locations this returns the surveyor-consultation handoff instead of a price — that is a normal outcome, not a failure. Prices are estimates confirmed on a specialist call; no booking or record is created by this tool.

subTypeIndex.description: The chosen sub-type's matrixIndex — required for quotable paths (chimney/wall/roof: 1–14)

answers.description: Answer VALUES from the path's question steps, in order — required for quotable paths

postcode.description: Customer's UK postcode — required for quotable paths (travel is priced into the total)

tier.description: Plan to price the headline total at (all three are returned regardless)

tools.name: beegone_request_visit
tools.title: Request a Beegone visit or callback
tools.description: Submit the customer's request to BeeGone. Call ONCE per customer, only after they agreed to be contacted. For quotable jobs (chimney/wall/roof): pass the answers, postcode and the plan tier the customer chose after seeing beegone_get_quote's three prices — this files a priced request and a BeeGone specialist calls to confirm details and arrange the work; nothing is charged online. For survey locations (tree, attic, soffit-eaves, shed-outbuilding) and general topics (garden, swarm, other): this captures the enquiry and a surveyor calls back — offer the customer the returned booker link to pick their own consultation time. Bumblebees (garden-compost): without the customer's details this returns the advice to relay (a nest is usually best left where it is); with their details and customerConfirmed it files a nest move (from £125 to move a bumblebee nest; nests inside walls, lofts or needing access work are quoted after a survey) and the office calls back. The customer is never signed up to marketing by this channel.

tier.description: REQUIRED for quotable paths — the plan the customer chose after seeing the prices

contact.description: Required for every request EXCEPT bumblebee advice (garden-compost): send it there only to file a nest move

phone.description: The specialist calls this number to confirm

businessName.description: Required when the answers say business property

customerConfirmed.description: Required (true) whenever contact details are submitted — the customer agreed to be contacted

hiveRulesAccepted.description: Required (true) for quotable-path submits — the customer was shown BeeGone's Hive Rules (terms) from beegone_get_questions and agreed, same as the calculator's required tickbox
